meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Lets you dim or hide The White Noise Machine's headline; hide the FAQ, headphones hint and theme switch
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on thewhitenoisemachine.com with desktop UA 1440x900 and iPhone UA 390x844, DOM captured after 7 seconds. The page is a single-screen Mantine/Next.js app: headline, intro, a noise-colour selector, three audio players, a hint line, an FAQ accordion, credits. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the colour selector and the audio players).

LIVE (same on both): `h1.mantine-Title-root` 2, `#__next > p.mantine-Text-root:nth-of-type(1)` 1 (intro), `...:nth-of-type(2)` 1 (headphones hint), `.mantine-Accordion-root` 1, `.mantine-Switch-root` 1. The original cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing: the page shows no cookie banner, ads or app prompt (only a Google Tag Manager noscript iframe), so there is no annoyance to add here.

Choices: Headline and intro Show/Dim/Hide.

Rules use Mantine's component class names (`mantine-Accordion-root`, `mantine-Title-root`), which are library names, not the hashed `m-xxxx` classes; the two paragraphs are told apart by their position among siblings.

NOT verified: other pages (Colours of Noise is an external link), behaviour after the audio is started, logged-in states (none exist).
